threat_event: A spoofed trade partner email changes bank details and weekly payments are diverted
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bank changes accepted by email with one approver; two losses in 2025-11 and 2026-02 ($1.1 million)
treatment_plan: Trade partner portal for bank changes with callback through SYS-G5 payee verification and a 10-day hold

threat_event: Users on the legacy Homebuilding email tenant are phished and their accounts used against the group
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SMS-only MFA; separate tenant without group mail-flow protections
treatment_plan: Migrate to SYS-G1 and SYS-G4 by 2027-03-31; interim number-matching MFA

threat_event: Builder administrator access kept on closed homes is used to unlock or watch homes
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Community administrator role not removed at handover for about 3,100 homes
treatment_plan: Remove builder roles from all closed homes; handover checklist enforced before closing

threat_event: A shared installer passcode lets someone take over hubs installed in 2023 and 2024
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One passcode across hubs; known to installers and trade partners
treatment_plan: Rotate passcodes remotely; unique per-home codes; notify affected homeowners

threat_event: Bank detail changes in SYS-H1 go undetected
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SYS-H1 logs not in the SIEM
treatment_plan: Collect SYS-H1 logs; alert on bank changes

threat_event: Purchasing staff edit trade partner bank details and approve their own changes
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: ERP roles combine vendor maintenance and purchasing
treatment_plan: Separate vendor master maintenance from purchasing

threat_event: A buyer deposit is not escrowed as the contract and state law require
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Manual deposit handling at 310 sales centers
treatment_plan: Daily reconciliation of deposits to escrow

threat_event: Ransomware on the Homebuilding ERP halts scheduling and trade payments
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: ERP administrators use standing privileged accounts
treatment_plan: Move ERP administration to group PAM

threat_event: A camera or access control device at a sales center becomes an entry point
treatment_plan: Device network zones at the 40 communities

threat_event: Buyer data from SYS-H2 is sent to Home Loans without documented consent
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Lead API sends all buyers, including those who declined lender contact
existing_controls: Affiliated business disclosure in the sales packet
treatment_plan: Send only buyers who opted in

threat_event: The design studio hosted payment page is tampered with
treatment_plan: Accepted: processor responsibility; link integrity checked monthly

threat_event: Homebuilding staff follow no division security standards because no supplement exists
treatment_plan: Issue a Homebuilding supplement and inheritance matrix

threat_event: A hurricane damages sales centers and jobsites
treatment_plan: Accepted: storm plans and cloud hosting cover systems

threat_event: Construction schedule optimization suggests unworkable or unsafe sequences (AI-008)
treatment_plan: Accepted: low impact with human approval

threat_event: ERP vendor remote support access is misused
A breach at the smart-home or warranty platform vendor exposes about 38,000 homeowners data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor never reviewed by the group
treatment_plan: Vendor SOC report review and contract notice terms
